stage: DEV-048 P0F / research-only evidence selection; NOT_APPROVED_FOR_PUBLICATION
rules: P0D/P0E validation is structural and SHA-based; not edition certification or XSD validation.
CANDIDATE_FINAL_RECHECK is not publication authorization; check real-world live URL, event binding, public accessibility, UX warning and licensing immediately before P1.
Only organizer-linked HTTPS target URLs with established file bytes are in candidate selection.
Official prior evidence without P0D/P0E recheck is held for source confirmation.
Replaced links and anonymous-unverified Drive links are held.
Over-10%-and-1-km discrepancies and serious name/date/geometric mismatches are held.
Unknown GPX file year is allowed only with explicit unknown-year label; never infer year from URL upload folder or GPS timestamps.
A year-labelled 2027 file is not necessarily a confirmed final course or edition registry binding.
The manifest preserves all per-file IDs, but duplicate target URLs especially ZIP-with-multiple-GPX must yield a single external link per race profile when rendered.
No GPX content is embedded or rehosted. No production modification, organizer outreach, auto merge, or deploy.
